source: Configuration of tools/content/checks/story_wiring.mjs (docs/design/alternate_history.md, SL-28, SL-29, SL-30). With `enforceAll` true (set on 25 October 2026, when every owner's findings were resolved) every finding of every owner stops the build; `enforce` keeps the owners that were enforced first. The findings are also staged in docs/design/validation/story_wiring_report.json and printed on the console. `allowance` lists flags that are read before their owner sets them, with that owner; an allowed flag is reported but never fails, and an allowed flag that is now set is reported as stale so the row can be removed.
